### 📌 Summary of Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### 👣 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to page '...'
2. Open URLComments popup / side panel
3. Click on '....'
4. See error

### 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### 📸 Screenshots & Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or console logs (`F12` / Inspect Popup) to help explain your problem.

### 💻 Environment
- **OS**: [e.g. macOS 15, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04]
- **Browser**: [e.g. Chrome 128, Brave 1.69, Edge 128]
- **URLComments Version**: [e.g. v1.0.2]
- **Target Page URL**: [e.g. https://example.com/post]

### 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. logged-in status, SPA website, network condition).
